mapper.select: SELECT st.spot_idx AS spotIdx, st.name AS name, st.region AS region, st.description AS description, st.rating_avg AS ratingAvg, (SELECT si.image_url FROM SPOT_IMAGE si WHERE si.spot_idx = st.spot_idx LIMIT 1) AS imageUrl FROM SPOT_TRAVEL st WHERE st.spot_active = 0 ORDER BY st.review_count DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT tp.plan_id AS planId, tp.title AS title, tp.destination AS destination, u.nickname AS nickname, DATEDIFF(tp.end_date, tp.start_date) AS nights FROM TRAVEL_PLAN tp JOIN USERS u ON tp.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE tp.is_public = 1 ORDER BY tp.created_at DESC LIMIT 6
